idea-plugin.name: Java Cup Icons
idea-plugin.description:
Java Cup Icons gives top-level Java classes and records a coffee-cup icon in the Project View and editor tabs.

Interfaces, enums, and annotation types keep the icons supplied by your active theme, so the distinction between Java types stays visible. The plugin works alongside your active icon theme and does not modify theme files.

  • Top-level classes and records: cup icon.
  • Interfaces, enums, annotations, and nested declarations: unchanged.
  • No settings, theme edits, telemetry, or background services.

Requires IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3 (build 263). Atom Material Icons is optional.

Source and issue tracker: github.com/stormizn/Java-Cup-Icons
